# Test Coverage Claim Extraction and Validation

This feature allows the extraction of claimed test coverage from a predefined documentation header ('kc-covers:') in source files and scores the claims against actual test plan recommendations. It supports validation of coverage claims, precision/recall measurement, and points out missing, extraneous, or nonexistent entities in the claim.
